a.xlink:title: Boot task (CubeMX's defaultTask): brings up every subsystem, then suspends itself.
Initializes the IMUs, barometers, GPS, servos and magnetometer.
Starts PWM, centres both servos, records the zero reference, and checks they hold position.
Configures the E22 module and leaves it in TRANS mode.
Caches the core clock in MHz for micros() and enables the DWT counter. FC_Init() calls this first,...
Mounts the card and opens HAL1_LOG.TXT for appending.
Initializes sensor A, plus B and C if TMR_Toggle.
Initializes BMI323 A, plus B and C if tmr_on.
Checks WHO_AM_I, resets the chip, and starts 100 Hz continuous mode.
Releases the module from reset, checks it answers, and sends the config.
Initializes the chip and starts continuous measurement.
Selects the chip-select pin, initializes the chip, and applies the flight config.
Sends a raw UBX message.
Writes both PWM compare registers for input plus the configured offsets (deg).
Converts readRawVoltage() to degrees relative to _zeroVoltage (360° per 3.3 V).
Reads both feedback voltages from ADC3 and smooths them.
Sets M0/M1 for mode, then waits up to 200 ms for AUX to go high.
Powers up the module, writes cfg to its flash, verifies it, and enters TRANS mode.
Waits for AUX to go high (module idle), polling every 1 ms.
Reads ADDH through REG3 from the module.
Writes ADDH through REG3 to the module.
Enables the DWT cycle counter and resets it to 0.
